newsitem.title: JAPAN: FUJI TV SHARES RISE SHARPLY ON BROKERS' BUYING.
newsitem.headline: FUJI TV SHARES RISE SHARPLY ON BROKERS' BUYING.

text.p: Shares in Fuji Television Network Inc continued to rise sharply in Tuesday's afternoon session on aggressive buying by brokers on their own accounts, brokers said.
As of 0536 GMT, the shares were up 53,000 at 728,000 yen, surpassing the previous high of 700,000 yen recorded on the first day of trading on August 8.
"The issue attracts brokers because it is unlikely to face aggressive selling in the near future as the stock was only listed recently," said a broker at a major Japanese brokerage.
The company is an affiliate of Nippon Broadcasting System Inc, which listed its shares in the TSE's second session in Dember 1996.
